guardrails: planning artifacts do not ingest analysis datasets
planning artifacts do not execute risk maps, abundance inference, human case maps, Rt, spillover, host-switch, or surveillance joins
each source still requires provenance, terms, field-schema, and bias review before analysis

plan.analysis_scope: public surveillance export provenance and schema evidence only; descriptive mapping already remains bounded elsewhere
remaining_blockers: aggregate reference-region filtering rule before downstream use
plan.verified_case_count_field: NumValue when Indicator=Reported cases and Unit=N
plan.verified_geography: country rows plus aggregate reference-region rows
plan.verified_time_granularity: annual rows such as 2008 and monthly rows such as 2008-01
